entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Strong-willed witch of Innistrad and leader of the Dawnhart Coven.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: Coven of witches reformed around Ghrin-Danu, led by Katilda.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: Ancient forest deity of the Dawnhart Coven.

entities.name: Saryth
entities.description: Powerful hedgewitch and former acolyte who wanted to worship additional gods.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker recruited to find the Moonsilver Key; offered her blood for the ritual.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group recruited by Katilda to find the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key needed for the Celestus ritual; held Katilda's soul after Olivia took it.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Site of the Harvesttide ritual.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: Festival organized by Katilda to gather human energy for the ritual.

entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Helped by Katilda to save her sister Sinnia.

entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: Leinore's sister, possessed by Saryth's power.

entities.name: Coiled One
entities.description: Creature Saryth's ritual aimed to summon.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Attacked the Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker whose intangibility let her bring the Key to Katilda.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who interrupted the ritual, took the Key and later planned to marry Edgar Markov.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Captive angel freed by Katilda's spirit.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Vampire Olivia intended to marry.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Tried to block the marriage, awakening Katilda's spirit.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Helped the party return to Celestus; borrowed the Key.

entities.name: Lier
entities.description: Fought alongside Katilda during the invasion.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi trapped in Innistrad's moon, causing darkness and cold.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Gothic plane of Katilda.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Katilda defended Innistrad.

events.summary: Katilda retreats to the Ulvenwald after Avabruck's destruction and reforms the Dawnhart Coven around Ghrin-Danu, emerging as leader.
events.quote: Katilda had emerged as their leader

events.summary: Katilda gathers the coven to reverse the darkness and organizes the Harvesttide festival, recruiting Arlinn and the Gatewatch for the Moonsilver Key.
events.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key

events.summary: Katilda helps Leinore save Sinnia from Saryth's possession.
events.quote: Katilda ended up helping Leinore to save her sister Sinnia

events.summary: Tovolar attacks the festival; Kaya brings the Key to Katilda and the ritual begins.
events.quote: Kaya 's intangibility let her run through the attack to bring the Key to Katilda

events.summary: Olivia interrupts the ritual, uses Katilda as hostage, takes the Key and hurls Katilda to the ground.
events.quote: After Olivia obtained the Key she launched Katilda towards the ground

events.summary: Katilda's soul is revealed to be in the Key; her spirit emerges to free Sigarda.
events.quote: Katilda manifested coming out of the Key in the form of a spirit, using her powers to free Sigarda.

events.summary: Katilda is returned to her body and the coven restores the balance of night and day; she lends the Key to Teferi.
events.quote: the balance between night and day was restored

events.summary: Katilda fights alongside Lier defending Innistrad in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Katilda fought alongside Lier in defense of Innistrad

relations.quote: She is the leader of the Dawnhart Coven .
Katilda was at odds with the young acolyte Saryth
using Katilda as a hostage for the Key
Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the Moonsilver Key
